# World Wide Steps

World Wide Steps is a public Snows ProAm project for exploring global step totals, athlete rankings and countries. The Irish Secondary School Step Challenge shows participating schools, student and school standings, and challenge information.

Public pages:
- Worldwide dashboard: https://worldwidesteps.com/
- Irish Secondary School Step Challenge: https://worldwidesteps.com/schools
- ProAm Store: https://worldwidesteps.com/shop
- Snows ProAm: https://snowsproam.com/

Step totals, rankings, school participation, product availability and prices are live data. Check the page for current values.
